meta_description:
3,594 likes, 384 comments - abybaig on November 2, 2025: "Awarded Best Travel Photographer of the Year by @TimesofIndia 🙏✨

This happened last evening!
Photography has been taking me to places I never even imagined. Nothing, just thankful to God for putting that rebel instinct inside me, that made me choose this art, even when the world told me not to.

There’s a special kind of joy when life rewards you for something you’ve given your whole self to. Honestly, after stepping into photography, I never chased opportunities, never went asking for work, never ran after numbers. I just kept doing my work with honesty, passion, and pure intention, and everything else started falling into place on its own.

Thank you to every single person who gave me even a little bit of courage along this journey, There’s still a long way to go.

And to all my fellow photographers, especially those just starting out, I know the beginning feels tough. You’ll face hurdles from all sides. But always trust your work, stay honest to your art, and keep putting your heart into it. Your work will take you to places you can’t even imagine today.

What’s meant for you will always find its way ❤️✨

.
.
.
#abybaig #Travelpowercreators2025
Journey, Photography, Photographer, Artist, Art, Award, Times of India, Travel, Travel photographer".
